name: Timor Cuckoo-Dove
rangeDescription: Timor, wetar, and adjacent eastern lesser sundas
description: A large, long-necked, long-tailed dove with a dark rufous-brown back, wings, and tail that are extensively barred. Paler rufous on the head and buffier below, with extensive barring in male birds, though female and juvenile birds are only faintly barred or lack barring below.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Madanga
rangeDescription: Buru (southern moluccas)
description: A little-known, highly unusual songbird confined to the island of Buru. Taxonomically confusing; formerly considered a white-eye, but now thought to be an abnormal, arboreal pipit.

name: Silver-rumped Spinetail
rangeDescription: Southern myanmar to malay peninsula and greater sundas and satellite islands
description: Small, bullet-shaped swift with rather broad-based wings. Dark (glossy blue in optimal light) with extensive silvery rump patch.

name: Hispaniolan Mango
rangeDescription: Hispaniola and satellite islands île-á-vache, tortue, gonâve, and beata
description: Hispaniola’s largest hummingbird. Adult male has a glittering green throat, black underparts, and violet tail.

name: Sulu Jungle Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Sulu archipelago (pangamian, jolo, and tawitawi)
description: Little-known and seemingly uncommon flycatcher of the Sulu Archipelago from Jolo south to Tawitawi. Drab brown overall, with a long slender bill; note pale throat and belly with diffusely dusky chest, as well as rufous tail.

name: Hildebrandt's Starling
rangeDescription: Acacia savanna of southern kenya and northern tanzania
description: A beautiful starling of savanna country. The upperparts are iridescent, with a purple sheen on the head and green on most of the wing.

name: Andean Gull
rangeDescription: Andean lakes of ecuador to northern argentina and central chile
description: Handsome hooded gull of the Andes; also ranges to coastal areas in nonbreeding season. Found at lakes, wetlands, and bogs; ranging to plowed fields and farmland, and beaches and river mouths on the coast.

name: Gray-sided Thrush
rangeDescription: Mountains of northeastern china (liaoning); winters to india and myanmar
description: A dull brown thrush with a gray belly and white eyebrows. Head pattern similar to that of Eyebrowed Thrush, but Gray-sided has no orange tones anywhere on the body.

name: Taiwan Barbet
rangeDescription: Taiwan
description: Highly distinctive Taiwan endemic, bright green with a rainbow-hued face in red, blue, and yellow. Inhabits forests, parks, and gardens from lowlands into montane regions.

name: Madeira Chaffinch
rangeDescription: Madeira
description: Dapper little finch endemic to Madeira, where it inhabits a range of habitats, from forests to farmlands. Handsome, brightly colored male has a blue-grayish cowl, pale orangish face and breast, and a black-and-white wing pattern (colors muted in winter).

name: Black-billed Barbet
rangeDescription: Eastern sudan to western ethiopia, northeastern democratic republic of the congo, uganda, western kenya, and northern tanzania
description: A medium-sized black barbet with a mostly red head. With a good look, pale edges to the wing feathers are visible.

name: Blaze-winged Parakeet
rangeDescription: Forest of northern paraguay and southwestern brazil (southwestern mato grosso)
description: Small parakeet with a long, pointed greenish-yellow tail. Has a brown crown, a scaled breast, and a variable-sized maroon belly patch.

name: Dark-billed Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Venezuela to the guianas, brazil, northern argentina, and galapagos
description: Brownish above and buff bellow with a black bill, black bandit mask, and gray crown. The eyering is yellowish and the eyes dark.

name: Cassia Crossbill
rangeDescription: South hills and albion mountains of south-central idaho (northwestern usa)
description: Stocky, large-headed finch with unique crossed bill used to pry seeds out of lodgepole pine cones. Similar to Red Crossbill, best separated by voice, specifically the flight calls given in flight, a comparatively lower frequency, dry

name: Javan Tesia
rangeDescription: Montane forest of java
description: Tiny short-tailed ground-dweller, restricted to foothill and montane forests on Java. Favors areas with dense, tangled undergrowth, in which it bounces around actively.

name: Hispaniolan Amazon
rangeDescription: Hispaniola and satellite islands
description: A stout green inhabitant of wooded habitats; typically found in flocks, sometimes numbering in the hundreds. No other native parrot occurs within its range.

name: Sinaloa Crow
rangeDescription: Coastal lowlands of western mexico (southern sonora to western nayarit)
description: Small glossy crow, common in northwest Mexico; endemic. Occurs in towns, villages, rubbish dumps, farmland, and semiopen areas with hedges and taller trees; often near water.

name: Shiny Whistling-Thrush
rangeDescription: Montane moss forest of sumatra
description: Chunky dark blue bird with a small bill and a short tail. Note iridescent spangling on the neck and brow of the male; female is plainer, with less iridescence.

name: Mandarin Duck
rangeDescription: Wooded ponds, swamps, and streams of northeastern asia from southeastern siberia, korean peninsula, japan, and eastern china
description: Small exotic-looking duck found at lakes and parks, usually with nearby trees. Male very ornate with big orangey

name: Arfak Robin
rangeDescription: Northwestern new guinea (tamrau and arfak mountains)
description: A medium-sized bird of moist montane forest in the west of New Guinea. Pale gray below, pale pink legs, an indistinct white mark in the wing and an obvious white mark below the eye.
